description: Two envelopes from one gate, each with its own loop switch, brought out singly, inverted, multiplied, averaged and as one raised to the power of the other

params.text: Scales the attack A control input before it is added to the attack A knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Scales the attack B control input before it is added to the attack B knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Sets the attack time of envelope A, up to a second
Sets the attack time of envelope B, up to a second
Bends both envelopes from a straight line towards an exponential shape, and it is applied to every output
Scales the decay A control input before it is added to the decay A knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Scales the decay B control input before it is added to the decay B knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Sets the decay time of envelope A, up to a second
Sets the decay time of envelope B, up to a second
Scales the sustain A control input before it is added to the sustain A knob, a tenth of the level per volt at full amount
Scales the sustain B control input before it is added to the sustain B knob, a tenth of the level per volt at full amount
Sets the level envelope A holds at while the gate is held
Sets the level envelope B holds at while the gate is held
Scales the release A control input before it is added to the release A knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Scales the release B control input before it is added to the release B knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Sets the release time of envelope A, up to a second
Sets the release time of envelope B, up to a second
Switches envelope A between holding at its sustain level and looping through attack and decay for as long as the gate is held
Switches envelope B between holding at its sustain level and looping through attack and decay for as long as the gate is held

inputs.text: Added to the attack A knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Added to the attack B knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Added to the decay A knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Added to the decay B knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Added to the sustain A knob through its CV knob, a tenth of the level per volt at full amount
Added to the sustain B knob through its CV knob, a tenth of the level per volt at full amount
Added to the release A knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Added to the release B knob through its CV knob, a tenth of a second per volt at full amount
Starts both envelopes, and has to read exactly 10V to do so; the channel count on this cable sets how many voices the module runs

outputs.text: Envelope A turned upside down, 10V at rest and 0V at its peak
Envelope A multiplied by envelope B, 0 to 10V
Envelope B turned upside down, 10V at rest and 0V at its peak
The product of the two envelopes turned upside down, 10V at rest
Envelope A raised to the power of envelope B, 0 to 10V

notes: the gate is tested for equality with 10V, so a gate of 5V or 8V never starts anything; use a source that puts out exactly 10V
a looping envelope loops only while the gate is held, and drops into its release the moment the gate goes away
the attack, decay and release times stop at one second: the knobs travel further than that but the total is clamped to one, so the top of their range makes no difference
the panel is lettered NVLOP3HR while the module browser and the plugin manifest call it ENVELOOP3HR
